title: EPOS EXPAND Vision 1M 4K Video Conferencing Camera

comparisons.notes: Same model 1001197 EPOS EXPAND Vision 1M, black, listed in stock

writeup: Woot has the EPOS EXPAND Vision 1M (model 1001197) in new condition for $69.99. It's a 4K/30fps USB-C meeting-room camera with ePTZ, intelligent framing, a motorized privacy shutter and Zoom and Microsoft Teams certification. Other US stores list it from about $601 up to $799, so this is roughly 88% below the cheapest one we found in stock.
